stem:
Kabir walks at a steady speed of 1.5 m/s along a straight path for 40 s.

Answer both parts.

parts.text: Which claim correctly finds the distance he covers?

options.text: Multiply 1.5 m/s by 40 s to get 60 m.
Divide 1.5 m/s by 40 s to get the distance.
Add 1.5 and 40 to get the distance in metres.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Distance covered equals speed multiplied by time, so 1.5 m/s × 40 s = 60 m.

teacher.key_rationale: At steady speed, distance = speed × time. Multiplying 1.5 by 40 gives 60 m; dividing or adding does not.
